name: Susenyos I
contribution: Emperor of Ethiopia from 1607 to 1632, and a member of the Solomonic dynasty.

checks.lead: Susenyos I (Ge'ez: ሱስንዮስ Sūsinyōs; c. 1571–1575 – 17 September 1632), also known as Susenyos the Catholic, was Emperor of Ethiopia from 1607 to 1632, and a member of the Solomonic dynasty. His throne names were Seltan Sagad and Malak Sagad III.
